stories.headline: Source: Nvidia's board is not considering bringing Jensen Huang back as CEO
stories.quote: SOURCE: NVIDIA'S BOARD IS NOT CONSIDERING BRINGING JENSEN HUANG BACK AS CEO AND IT IS FOCUSED ON A NATIONAL SECURITY INVESTIGATION INTO HUANG

facts.text: President Trump says he would not mind if Huang were reinstated as CEO
facts.quote: PRESIDENT TRUMP SAYS HE “WOULD NOT MIND” IF JENSEN HUANG WAS REINSTATED AS NVIDIA'S CEO

facts.text: Sources: Huang had planned to pull back Nvidia's financing and told neoclouds to get upfront customer payments
